scope: Forward-reference statistics use the declared training Gaussian law, not archived actual training draws.
Paired residual uses one expert continuation; alternative plausible trajectories and generated errors both raise it. It is not proof of unconditional OOD or unique cause.
Quaternion norm has an analytic noncentral-chi reference for a unit clean quaternion; float32 target norm errors are negligible at this scale.
Nearest-center test is unconditional one-quaternion coverage only. It ignores context, future index and joint16-step trajectory. Passing it cannot establish conditional competence.
All correlated frames/seeds retained descriptively; no independent-sample significance claim or policy/counterfactual score.
Only4rotation components were traced.7Djoint pose distribution, hidden context and low-noise network response to teacher-forced inputs are not available.
